title: ADR Frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of an Architecture Decision Record.

title.description: Short imperative title for the decision.

date.description: Date the decision was made, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

deciders.description: Roles or people who made the decision.

supersedes.description: ID of an ADR that this ADR supersedes, or null.

superseded_by.description: ID of the ADR that supersedes this one, or null.

lint_rules.description: Linter rule IDs that guard this decision.

ci_checks.description: CI job names or script paths that verify compliance.

enforcement.description: How this rule is enforced in CI/runtime.

linked_prd.description: Path or URL to a PRD section motivating this ADR, or null.

linked_research.description: Path or URL to a research/spike document, or null.
